recipe.visualDefinition: A retro-styled album cover featuring a high-contrast black and white portrait framed within a rounded-corner rectangle, set against a solid ochre-brown background with prominent Western-style display typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The ochre background acts as a wide border for the central monochrome image.
The top-heavy typography balances the visual weight of the portrait below.
Rounded corners on the image frame soften the transition between the photo and the solid background.
coreInvariants: Black and white high-contrast portrait photography
Rounded-corner rectangular frame with a thin black stroke
Western slab-serif display type with thick outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, outlined display text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down to the subtitle flanked by flourishes, and settle on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the ochre header area to accommodate large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ochre-brown (#966F22) provides the primary background and retro atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white within the portrait and text outlines provide sharp definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white or light cream for the text fill to ensure legibility against the dark ochre.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, medium-dark value background contrasted with high-value highlights in the portrait.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with Western/Cowboy characteristics
letterConstructionRules: Strong black outlines with a slight offset or double-stroke effect
Internal decorative notches or spurs typical of 19th-century wood type
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are filled with a light cream color and outlined in black to pop from the ochre background.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy Western display type paired with a light, spaced-out serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Curly calligraphic flourishes flanking the subtitle
Rounded-corner rectangular frame for the main image
Angled 'stamp' style logo in the bottom corner

avoid: Sharp 90-degree corners on the photo frame

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Western wood-type aesthetic with decorative spurs.
Classic slab serif with the appropriate weight and retro feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid ochre-brown background. In the center-bottom, place a black and white high-contrast portrait of a woman with 1960s styled hair, contained within a rounded-corner rectangular frame with a thin black border. Leave the top third of the canvas empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large Western-style slab serif text in the top third, centered, with cream fill and thick black outlines. Below it, add a smaller serif subtitle in black, flanked by two symmetrical curly flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent ochre-brown?
Is the portrait strictly black and white?
Does the main text have a distinct Western slab-serif look?
Are the corners of the photo frame rounded?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between title and subtitle

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is centered and legible.
Check that the rounded corners of the frame are symmetrical.
Verify the ochre color is not too yellow or too red.
Confirm the flourishes do not touch the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid retro background + rounded frame monochrome portrait + Western display type header.
